research: Weekly briefs 26 Oct-8 Nov: Slouchy Vintage Bag best product 26 Oct-1 Nov (ROAS 2.42); its winners MAX-33-H5 and C9_V2 sell the clasp, the compartments and three ways to wear

Rulebook: keep a colours ('Which colour are you?', Vintage next) and a value static; benefit headlines; offer once and big

Formats never used for Vintage: neon offer, macro detail, rubber stamp, colour split + one new (corkboard instant photo)
